extraction_instructions: Elementor loop cards (10 per page, 3 pages, rel=next / 'page-numbers next' link) at /what-we-do/events/, event pages under /event/<slug>/. Card has title, 'D - D Month, YYYY' and 'City, Country'. Detail pages are thin 'Key Information' blocks (Location / Dates / Topic); only Summit microsites carry a Venue address and fee tables. 'Talk Liver To Me' podcast episodes are skipped. Schools / Academy / Masterclass / Bootcamp pages are application-only courses with no fee. Register now / Visit Website external link is stored as organiser_url.

Sitefinity (not WordPress) card list, 8 per page over 3 pages, upcoming first. Card: <section class=search-news__result> with title link (internal page or external Cvent link), <date> with <sup> ordinals, category button. Detail pages are free-form blurbs (Date / Location / Event information / Registration fees: / Find out more and register) inside one ASP.NET <form>; fees are written as prose (Consultant: GBP 120, Trainee: GBP 80; 'GBP 500 (Early Bird before ...)'). Many pages only link to the organiser's own site, stored as organiser_url.

One page with a 'Next events' card grid (upcoming) followed by a 'Past events' grid that loads more by admin-ajax infinite scroll; the Past grid is irrelevant, so the page is cut at that heading and no paging is needed (no ?page= or REST alternative exposes dates). Detail pages (/events/<slug>/) open with 'LIVES, Month D-D, YYYY, City (Venue)' and sometimes a venue line; the annual congress page has three fee grids (member / non-member rows x early / standard / late / one-day columns).

Modern Events Calendar list skin: month dividers ('November 2026') then article cards with year-less dates ('04 - 27 Jan'); the year comes from the divider. No load-more control renders and /wp-json/mec/v1/events returns []. Detail pages hold a 'Book Event' ticket block (name, price with or without GBP sign, 'Available Tickets: N') and a JSON-LD Event; the hidden 'ticket is sold out' sentence under every ticket is a template, not a signal. Webinars are online; the congress sells tickets on pccongress.org.uk (PDF price list).

source_name: ERA Events (other events, Congress, Education, CME)
extraction_instructions:
era-online.org has no single event archive. Shells come from four places: (A) /events/other-events/ blocks (title, 'Month D - D, YYYY
City, Country', VISIT THE EVENT WEBSITE = third-party endorsed meetings whose booking_url is the organiser's own site); (B) ERA Congress pages /events/-/ linked from that page; (C) 'will take place' entries on /events/era-education-meetings/; (D) /cme-courses/ own pages (dd/mm/yyyy range, Venue:, fee lines) plus the Registry epidemiology course. For (A) dates and place come from the ERA block and the external site is not scraped for fees. Invitation-only ERA Science Meetings are skipped.

eusem.org is Joomla/K2 with no structured events list: /events is a news feed and the RSEvents calendar is empty. The listing override reads the home-page menu links to /education/courses-traineeships/<slug>, loads each article and keeps those stating an upcoming date (Date(s) label, else first non-deadline line with a full date). Detail is prose: fee rows under a bare 'Fee' heading, venue under a 'Venue' label. The Congress (eusemcongress.org) is a separate site and the 2026 edition is over.

WooCommerce shop behind Cloudflare: plain httpx with the default headers gets 403 and http_fetch's fresh-context fallback receives a 80 kB challenge page with no marker, so every fetch uses the browser's own page. /all-courses/ links /product/<slug>/ pages; each single-course page carries data-product_variations JSON listing every (location, date) pair, which becomes one course parent plus one course_sessions row per pair. Fee = p.price ('From:' prefix on variable-price courses). Multi-form packages and undated products are skipped.

biasp.org/events/ is ONE Elementor page of free-form blocks 'Title / Date(s): / Location: / CLICK HERE (Fitwise or organiser link)', mixing BIASP meetings with third-party stroke events. No per-event pages: each block becomes a shell keyed by /events/#<slug>, with detail built from the block (the scraper's load of the booking page is ignored). Year-less dates ('13 October') resolve to the next occurrence. Fees are never on the page; the unwrapped registration link is kept as organiser_url / booking_url.

concrete5 'event_list' block: 8 server-rendered cards (title link ?occurrenceID=N, date '18 Nov 2026 - 22 Nov 2026'), 20 per load; the Load more control is empty because 8 < 20. Handled by the family listing walker with no override. Event pages are prose: venue/format come from sentences or a 'Title | date | time | venue' line (extractor overrides); registration and fees are on external Fitwise/EventsAir or society sites (kept as organiser_url).

Events Manager. /sam-events/ shows only 7 featured events; the full list (24 upcoming, mostly FAMUS/FUSIC/PoCUS courses) is on /events/categories/famus/ and /events/categories/other-events/, so the listing unions the three. Listing-card dates are split into spans and wrong; each event page's H1 ('FAMUS Course, 9 October 2026, Wirral') and its 'dd/mm/yyyy @ All Day' line give title and dates. Fees are free text ('Cost: GBP 350', 'Costs / Day 1: ...', 'Fees: ... (NNUH) ... External').
